formal_adoption: Root annotation quotes all extra actual requests. Direct public JSON/existing-frame/artifact use is separated from native data/computation/new observations. Correct final quality is not identical to direct adoption.

all supported source surfaces bound with current complete/readable witnesses

freshness: Own formal files/process/generation/phase ledger establish current evidence. Identical opaque ref strings across qualification/formal are allowed and are not themselves evidence of cache sharing.
independent_truth: Exact fixed-source plane-shadow intersection and full-frustum clip arithmetic. Actual RGB/raw source IDs independently determine16/4/24. Product complete is never the sole geometry oracle.
missing_fields: Failure/unmeasured, never filled true from oracle.
private_identity: TRUTH roi_id is a private label. Public IDs are bound through actual source object/host/name/local triangles and reconstructed world-quad set/front, with equivalent legal u/v basis accepted.

qualified_statuses.not_realized: Required discriminating actual pattern absent. Stop without changing scene.
qualified_statuses.product_incorrect: Independently supported geometry/pixels contradict current product facts. Stop formal.
qualified_statuses.qualified: passed true; first actual readable target row is incomplete, another delivered row complete/readable, public complete witness current and correct.

readers: Generation-time stdlib PNG/NPY reader matched pinned Pillow/NumPy14/14 fields on one sealed VIEW512 frame. Current formatted oracle AST matches archived generation source. Optional native evidence uses NumPy/Pillow directly, with independent masks/contrast counts.
stop_rule: Any qualification non-qualified ends this batch. Formal outcomes also end after one session. No replacement case/sample or prompt/threshold/product tuning.
